sources.title: Introducing: Devstral 2 and Mistral Vibe CLI
sources.evidence: The December 9, 2025 announcement introduces Devstral 2 as a 123B dense Transformer for software-engineering agents with a 256K context window and Modified MIT license. It separately identifies Devstral Small 2 as the 24B Apache 2.0 model; those specifications are not transferred here.

sources.title: Devstral 2 — Mistral model documentation
sources.evidence: Identifies Devstral 2, December 9, 2025 and the exact API identifier devstral-2512; lists native function calling. The Weights tab, inspected in the page HTML embedded data, links the exact Devstral-2-123B-Instruct-2512 checkpoint and lists Parameters (B)=123, Active (B)=123, Modified MIT and 256k context. The page marks API deprecation May 22, 2026; no endpoint operation was tested.

sources.title: Devstral 2 123B Instruct 2512 model card — pinned revision
sources.evidence: The official card describes this exact FP8 instruction checkpoint as a software-engineering model that uses tools to explore repositories and edit files. Its model-size table reports 123B and its features state 256K context. The deployment example selects this checkpoint with the Mistral tool-call parser and automatic tool choice.

sources.title: Devstral 2 123B Instruct 2512 configuration — pinned revision
sources.evidence: Config declares Ministral3ForCausalLM, 88 layers, hidden size 12288, 96 attention heads and 8 key/value heads, untied embeddings, vocabulary 131072, FP8 quantization and max_position_embeddings=262144. This is a text causal-LM configuration; generic vision-module names in quantization exclusions do not establish image support.

sources.title: Devstral 2 Modified MIT License — pinned revision
sources.evidence: The actual license is Modified MIT, attributed to Mistral AI in 2025. It requires retention of the notice and excludes companies whose global consolidated monthly revenue exceeded US$20 million in the preceding month; those users need separate commercial permission or hosted services. This is not the Apache 2.0 license of Devstral Small 2.

sources.title: Replace stray reasoning tokens with reserved slots — merged official checkpoint change
sources.evidence: On June 30, 2026, Mistral organization member Julien Denize explicitly classified this exact checkpoint as non-reasoning and explained that unused reasoning-token names were being removed to prevent incorrect capability detection. The change was merged. The discussion API confirms the author is an organization member, the target repository and merge status.

sources.title: Official Devstral 2 checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: The repository is public and ungated at revision 1613bf01adb5e1c6fdc196b46e6b173eae75eb4a. A bounded request for the first eight bytes of an indexed shard returned HTTP 206 and the requested bytes. Safetensors metadata reports 125025989840 storage elements; this quantized aggregate is not substituted for the explicitly published nominal parameter count.

sources.title: Devstral 2 chat template — pinned revision
sources.evidence: The template accepts text content and rejects non-text content chunks. It serializes native available-tool schemas, assistant tool calls and tool results, supporting the text-only modality and native tool-call classifications for this checkpoint.

sources.title: Devstral 2 FP8 tensor index — pinned revision
sources.evidence: The Transformers-format index maps 2027 tensor entries across 27 weight shards, including quantization scale entries. Its metadata total_parameters is 125025989840. No complete learned-parameter tensor census was performed; the FP8 storage metadata is not treated as a distinct exact parameter disclosure.

name.note: The exact released model is Devstral 2; the checkpoint is its 123B Instruct 2512 release.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the announcement, official checkpoint and license; retain the catalog developer label.

family.note: The announcement identifies Devstral 2 as part of the Devstral coding-model family.

release_date.note: The dated launch announcement and exact model documentation agree on the public release day.

open_weights.note: Official weights are public and ungated. An eight-byte HTTP range probe succeeded; open weights does not imply an unrestricted open-source license.

license.note: Use the exact license title. The preceding-month global consolidated company revenue restriction is US$20 million, not an annual limit; do not substitute Small 2 Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions explicitly published for this exact model. The FP8 index storage aggregate of 125.025989840B is not a complete learned-parameter census and does not replace the nominal disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: The official exact-checkpoint Weights table explicitly labels Active (B)=123. This is a nominal published value with no further accounting definition; it is not inferred by equating dense active parameters with total parameters.

architecture.note: The announcement explicitly says dense Transformer. The checkpoint configuration corroborates a decoder-only causal LM with grouped-query attention; no mixture-of-experts inference is needed.

context_window.note: The nominal 256K context is specified exactly as 262144 positions in the checkpoint configuration.

modalities.note: The exact checkpoint is text-only: its causal-LM config and chat template support text and reject non-text chunks. Small 2 image support and generic quantization exclusion names are not evidence of Devstral 2 image support.

reasoning.note: A Mistral organization member explicitly calls this checkpoint non-reasoning in a merged maintenance change. Old unused reasoning tokens do not establish a trained reasoning mode.

tool_call.note: Native function calling is documented for devstral-2512 and implemented in the exact checkpoint tool schema/call/result template.

description.value: Mistral's coding-agent model for repository work, terminal tasks, and software fixes
description.note: The original description is supported by the coding-agent launch, repository exploration, terminal-agent integration and multi-file software-editing use cases.

patch.notes: Mistral explicitly reports nominal total and active counts of 123B for Devstral 2. The quantized checkpoint storage aggregate is not an exact learned-parameter count. Modified MIT excludes companies with preceding-month global consolidated revenue above US$20 million unless separately licensed. The exact checkpoint is text-only and explicitly non-reasoning, with native tool calls. Mistral documents API deprecation on May 22, 2026; public weights remain available.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for Devstral 2 / devstral-2512. Fill Modified MIT, nominal 123B total and explicitly documented 123B active parameters, and dense architecture; replace the catalog release source with the dated primary announcement. Confirm 262144-token text-only context, native tools and explicitly non-reasoning behavior. Do not conflate the sibling Small 2 license/modalities or FP8 storage aggregates with this model. Current API deprecation is recorded without claiming endpoint availability.
